status.lemma_B2_grouping: PROVED (sympy identity; numerically on all forests n<=14)
status.lemma_G2_toolbox: PROVED (each inequality asserted on all forests n<=14)
status.lemma_H2_conditional_bound: PROVED (Q5 >= L under the side conditions; L exact at stars; checked on 183 larger trees n in {25,30,40} (183 with side conditions holding) and on all small forests where the side conditions hold)
status.sparse_forests_scanned_n: PROVED (exact scan + Lemma H''): Q_5 >= 0 for every forest of order n with e <= e_max(n): n=20: e<=14, n=25: e<=18, n=30: e<=23, n=40: e<=32, n=60: e<=50
status.analytic_closure: EXPLORED - the chain does NOT close: min of L over the relaxed region is negative for n in [20, 25, 30, 40, 60]; resisting terms: 6 p4 (Z - T5lo) (the five non-star 6-vertex trees + slack of the T5 tangent), the T4 tangent slack times the large negative T4 coefficient, and F <= (e-3)P4/2
status.exhaustive_base: PROVED: Q_5 >= 0 for every forest with n <= 20 (3269193 forests, 3258430 with alpha >= 9, 0 negatives)
status.theorem_D_delta_le_2: PROVED: Q_5 >= 0 for every forest with Delta <= 2 (linear forests): the independence polynomial is real-rooted (I(P_k;x) = matching polynomial of P_{k+1}, Heilmann-Lieb; products of real-rooted polynomials), and Newton's inequalities give r p_r^2 >= (r+1) p_{r-1} p_{r+1}; 507 such forests among n<=14 checked
status.ISO5_all_forests: PARTIAL: proved for n <= 20 (exhaustive) and for Delta <= 2 (all n); the analytic chain Q5 >= L is proved but L is not nonnegative on the relaxed region, so no Bernstein certificate is possible for it
